notes.title: Can this game make you scream?
notes.notes:
[b]STEAM Scream Fest 3 (Halloween 2024)[/b] is coming up [b]from Oct. 28 to Nov. 4[/b]!

During that time, Head To Hell will get [b]40%OFF[/b]!

Besides, players who [b]have purchased[/b] HTH will also get [b]new contents![/b]:  
[olist]
[*] We optimized game's [b]guide and storyline[/b] to let player have a smoother 
     and a more holistic gameplay.
[*] The old version (before Oct. 28th) was transfered to [b]downloadable content[/b]— 
     Head To Hell: Olden Days.
[*] By the way, we added [b]Japanese[/b] language!
[/olist]
Wishing all passengers a pleasant journey! :)

notes.title: We made a small mistake🥲 (but not affect gameplay)
notes.notes:
We made a small mistake🥲 (but not affect gameplay)

The DLC Olden Days for Head To Hell was released by misclick.

If you download Olden Days now, [b]nothing changes[/b] because we haven't uploaded this pack.🤫

Head To Hell: Olden Days and New Head To Hell will be published in 25, Oct.

Sincerely sorry for our mistake.

[b]Intro:[/b] Olden Days is the old version of Head To Hell (the version of Head To Hell now), we plan to transfer this confusing version to a free DLC, and publish a NEW version (a new story but the game mechanics are same)
